title: PLC & ladder logic
circuit: Two-conveyor start: START (NO) / STOP (NC) seal-in for M1, TON 5 s starts M2, STOP drops both (program.md)

candidates.name: Pad-native ladder
candidates.oneLine: Own scan engine; SVG rungs with live power trace, TON gauge, moving conveyors, timing chart.
candidates.accuracy: check-pad-native-ladder.mjs replays program.json's answer key through the engine in Node: 46/46 PASS (10 ms scan, IEC TON)
candidates.caveats: Layout engine handles series, one-level branches, contacts, coils and TON only; plant is visual only; tested in emulated touch, not on a device.

candidates.name: PLCSimulator.online
candidates.oneLine: The live app (app.plcsimulator.online) in an iframe; student builds the rungs.
candidates.accuracy: not checked: the program cannot be loaded (cloud share links need sign-in, no file import)
candidates.caveats: Author banner says it is no longer developed (points to closed rungs.dev); AdSense and Google Tag Manager run inside the frame; drag-and-drop rung building.

candidates.name: Ladder Logic Editor (cdilga)
candidates.oneLine: Structured Text editor that generates the ladder; self-hosted build, program preloaded.
candidates.accuracy: App's own interpreter and store replayed in Node (checks/cdilga-lle.result.txt): 10/14 PASS; M2 switches on 1 scan late and off 2 scans late (100 ms scan)
candidates.caveats: Dark IDE look, rungs do not light up (power flow not wired); program loads via same-origin localStorage, so the live demo can't be preloaded.

candidates.name: CircuitJS relay ladder
candidates.oneLine: Same logic as a hardwired relay circuit: K1 seal-in, 5 s on-delay relay, lamps.
candidates.accuracy: check-circuitjs-relay.mjs presses the switches in headless Chrome, logs every time step: 5/5 PASS (M2 5.010 s after M1, STOP drops all within 20 ms)
candidates.caveats: Electrical sim, not a PLC: no scan, no ET readout; circuit shrinks to tiny on a phone; lamps stand in for motors.
